title: Web-Based AI-first Game Maker (Nights & Weekends Project)
author: FuckBernieSanders420
selftext:
This is a nights-and-weekends project I've been working on: a no code game builder. Just tell the chat bot how you want your game to work, ask it to make revisions, or generate models. Try out the "racing game" example to see how it works, or watch this demo video: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CUaCDBzyxgQ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CUaCDBzyxgQ)

It's free so you can try it out now! Would love your feedback and feature requests, thanks!

[https://vibegamestudio.com/app](https://vibegamestudio.com/app)

And here's a few demo games I've cooked up:  
[https://vibegamestudio.com/api/assets/cm8ktq1ef0012dzrrbumoj4wa/html](https://vibegamestudio.com/api/assets/cm8ktq1ef0012dzrrbumoj4wa/html)  
[https://vibegamestudio.com/api/assets/cm8oi3e32006qw4pss1z1u24f/html](https://vibegamestudio.com/api/assets/cm8oi3e32006qw4pss1z1u24f/html)

Games are shareable, so if you make something cool post it in the comments 👇

comments.author: CaptPic4rd
comments.body:
I like that it uses 3d models, that's better than some of these other vibe-game platforms I've seen. But it's like, why would I use this platform? Can I monetize my game? Are the games better than what I can build myself with AI in a couple of hours?

Also, your racing game is just an open-world tech demo with bad controls. There isn't even a race to win.

replies.author: FuckBernieSanders420
replies.body:
its just for fun, not professional game dev and transmitting money is a can of worms im not interested in opening. letting folks export a .zip they can upload to [itch.io](http://itch.io) is on the roadmap somewhere, though, and they support monetization.

\>Also, your racing game is just an open-world tech demo with bad controls. There isn't even a race to win.

it is really just a demo, i gotta spruce it up a bit

\>Also also, I wouldn't lock the website behind a google sign in. I'm not giving you my google info because I dont really know what that entails and I am security-conscious. I closed the tab.

unfortunately its necessary to have some sorta sign in to prevent abuse and google sign in is by far the easiest and most secure way for me to offer that. the app doesnt request anything from google except your login ID and public profile information.
